Documento financiero sintético. Resume su tema sin repetir datos personales ni credenciales.

PENSIÓN PLAN AGREEMENT

This Pension Plan Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of this 1st day of January, 2023 (the "Effective Date"), by and between the following parties:

I. THE CHURCH COMMUNITY

Name: Entidad de Ejemplo
Tax ID Number: 000-00-0000
Address: Calle Ficticia 1, Ciudad de Prueba, Ciudad de México, 01230, México

II. Ana Prueba

Name: Ana Prueba
Tax ID Number: 
Address: Calle Ficticia 1, Ciudad de Prueba, Ciudad de México, 01230, México

III. THE PLAN

This Agreement establishes a Church Plan (the "Plan") for the benefit of the Participant, who is an employee of the Church Community. The Plan is designed to provide the Participant with a source of income during retirement and to comply with the unique regulatory and compliance requirements applicable to religious organizations.

IV. ELIGIBILITY

The Participant is eligible to participate in the Plan as of the Effective Date, provided that the Participant is an employee of the Church Community and meets the following criteria:

1. The Participant must be a member of the Church Community.
2. The Participant must be at least 18 years of age.
3. The Participant must work at least 20 hours per week.

V. CONTRIBUTIONS

1. The Church Community will make contributions to the Plan on behalf of the Participant.
2. The Church Community will contribute an amount equal to 10% of the Participant's compensation.
3. Contributions will be made on a quarterly basis.

VI. INVESTMENT OPTIONS

The Plan will offer the following investment options:

1. Money Market Fund
2. Bond Fund
3. Stock Fund
4. Balanced Fund

VII. DISTRIBUTION RULES
